cache_adapter.purpose: Forward LAKE_CACHE_DIR, LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE and LAKE_RESTORE_ARTIFACTS through Landrun's clean environment. All comparator-supplied sandbox restrictions and command arguments are preserved.
cache_adapter.cache: Private cache under the project's .lake directory; immutable artifacts are hard-linked from the host cache and output metadata is copied independently.
